text.name: Mew

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Mysterious Tail
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck, reveal an Item card you find there, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

text.flavor: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Roar of the Sword
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a {Psychic} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

attacks.name: Storm Slash
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each {Psychic} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Luminous Sign
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Aqua Return
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Manaphy

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Wave Veil
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

text.flavor: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

text.name: Radiant Greninja

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Concealed Cards
abilities.text: You must discard an Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Moonlight Shuriken
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: Radiant Pokémon Rule
rules.text: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

text.flavor: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

text.name: Ralts

attacks.name: Teleportation Burst
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

text.name: Kirlia

attacks.name: Mirage Step
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Kirlia and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

text.name: Gardevoir

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Shining Arcana
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and attach any number of basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Put the other cards into your hand.

attacks.name: Brainwave
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each {Psychic} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

text.name: Ralts

attacks.name: Memory Skip
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.

text.flavor: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

text.name: Kirlia

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Refinement
abilities.text: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

text.flavor: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

text.name: Cresselia

attacks.name: Moonglow Reverse
attacks.text: Move 2 damage counters from each of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

text.flavor: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Psychic Embrace
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic {Psychic} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your {Psychic} Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. You can't use this Ability on a Pokémon that would be Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Miracle Force
attacks.text: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Level Ball
effect: Search your deck for a Pokémon with 90 HP or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Collapsed Stadium
effect: Each player can't have more than 4 Benched Pokémon. If a player has 5 or more Benched Pokémon, they discard Benched Pokémon until they have 4 Pokémon on the Bench. The player who played this card discards first. If more than one effect changes the number of Benched Pokémon allowed, use the smaller number.

rules.text: This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Fog Crystal
effect: Search your deck for a {Psychic} Energy card or a Basic {Psychic} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Forest Seal Stone

abilities.label: VSTAR Power
abilities.name: Star Alchemy
abilities.text: During your turn, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

effect: The Pokémon V this card is attached to can use the VSTAR Power on this card.

rules.label: Pokémon Tool
rules.text: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Lost Vacuum
effect: You can use this card only if you put another card from your hand in the Lost Zone.
Choose a Pokémon Tool attached to any Pokémon, or any Stadium in play, and put it in the Lost Zone.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Artazon
effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box and put it onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

rules.text: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

text.name: Boss's Orders
effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Pal Pad
effect: Shuffle up to 2 Supporter cards from your discard pile into your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Iono
effect: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Super Rod
effect: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Professor's Research
effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Rare Candy
effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Reversal Energy
effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {Colorless} Energy.

If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, and if this card is attached to an Evolution Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes), this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 3 Energy at a time.

text.name: Ultra Ball
effect: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.
Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Battle VIP Pass
effect: You can use this card only during your first turn.
Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
